_meanings:
.²1 A Brāhmaṇa who has performed the ceremony of ablution which has to
 be performed on his finishing his first Āśrama (that of a Brahmachārin);
 {#rAjasnAtakayoScEva snAtako nfpamAnaBAk#} <ls>Ms. 2. 139</ls>.
.²2 A Brāhmaṇa just returned from the house of his preceptor and become
 an initiated householder ({#gfhasTa#}).
.²3 A Brāhmaṇa who is a {%Bhikṣu%} (beggar of alms) for any religious
 object; {#navEtAn snAtakAn vidyAd brAhmaRAn DarmaBikzukAn#} <ls>Ms. 11. 2</ls>.
.²4 Any man of the first three classes who is an initiated householder.
the vows and duties of a {#snAtaka#}.
